name: Layout engines
responsibility: Settles cards, frames, routes and labels as one drawing, with the engine the render names: Track or Blocks
description: Nothing after it may repair a coordinate. Blocks, the default, packs each container and group as a block of its own. Track lays the reading out with its containers drawn inline. Both rank cards with Graphviz and route on tracks, and Blocks routes the trunks between its blocks with the orthogonal router. draw states the graph, takes one solve, fits the page to the drawing and settles its crossings. Every variant is laid out fresh (ADR 0032, ADR 0040, ADR 0061).
